items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-10-14
items.q: My brother was with the band at the Lakefront with Daryl Poinnell, Willie Humphrey and them people.

ctx.x: Oh, you were at the Cross River there.
My brother was with the band at the Lakefront with Daryl Poinnell, Willie Humphrey and them people. Yeah.
And then you played in the Navy band? Yeah. Navy band. Yeah.
